posts.author: bringerofdata
posts.text: Career punting yards, 1960-2026, by each punter's Nth game with a punt.Jeff Feagles ends on 71,211 — about 40 miles, and the NFL record. But he doesn't lead until game 338 of 352. At game 337 he trailed Shane Lechler by 21 yards.His 41.6-yard average is the worst on his own top ten; Lechler's 47.6 is the best in NFL history and still loses by 2,535. Feagles never missed a game in 22 seasons.Data: pro-football-reference, nflverse.#nfl #football #dataviz #barchartrace

posts.author: Woodstoc
posts.text: #Bucs have had 10 straight one possesion games (longest active streak) so you knew this would be a dog fight. They're a well coached outfit. #nfl #cowboys

posts.author: LRiddickESPN@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: An #NFL offense with a rookie backup QB should never be able to possess the ball for nearly an entire quarter on the way to a scoring drive. Unless you help them along with dumb penalties and simply poor fundamental execution. Unreal.

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Jon Gruden BLASTS the Steelers: “Their defense has really let me down. They’ve got the highest-priced defense and they let Deshaun Watson drop back to pass, no pressure, take them right down the field. I think their defense is struggling. They just traded Joey Porter Jr., and Jamel Dean is out. I don’t know who the hell the starting corners are gonna be for Pittsburgh. Wake this damn defense up. I’m mad at Pittsburgh right now. I’m really mad at them. Because after the Bengal game, I thought they had everything they needed.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: TSN_Sports@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Javonte Williams opens the scoring on Thursday Night Football! #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Bruce Arians states when he was fired from the Steelers it was the best thing that ever happened to him: “I got back and talked to Mike. He was very happy, then went down to the lake and called me on Monday to tell me I didn't have a job anymore, so it was time to move on. It was hard. It's always hard, especially when you like a place that much, and I loved the players so much. But it was probably the best thing that ever happened to me. I'd probably never have been a head coach otherwise. I went to Indianapolis when Chuck got sick, got to be the interim coach, and ended up winning Coach of the Year, which opened the door for me to become a head coach. Because after Super Bowl XLIII, I never even got a phone call.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: News just a couple hours before kickoff: The Cowboys have ruled out CB Joey Porter Jr. with an illness.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Good news: Steelers S DeShon Elliott has returned to practice, though he remains on IR.

Bad news: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr aggravated his foot injury, and coach Mike McCarthy said he'll miss multiple weeks. Pittman had been dealing with plantar fasciitis.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
The Cowboys are activating All-Pro G Tyler Smith from Injured Reserve to play tonight against the Bucs. A big lift.

One of the NFL's best, Smith had thumb surgery right before the season, hoping to return as soon as possible. After a full practice on Wednesday, he's back.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: With the Colts losing Arden Key for a few weeks with an injury, they signed veteran edge Carl Lawson to their practice squad.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Vikings are signing WR Odell Beckham Jr to their practice squad, a move that adds veteran depth to the WR room and is a reunion with Kevin O’Connell and others who were with him with the Rams.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Cardinals add a former first-rounder in Jedrick Wills…

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Rams signed veteran LB Eric Kendricks to the practice squad.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The procedure will be done at the respected and nearby Vincera Institute made famous by Dr. William C. Meyers.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Eagles RB Tank Bigsby suffered an injury on Sunday and now requires core muscle surgery to repair it, sources say. Bigsby is headed to Injured Reserve, with hopes he’s back in six weeks or shorter.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The NFL confirmed today that line judge Jeff Seeman has been suspended for two games and referee Adrian Hill has been suspended for one game, each for an instance of unprofessional conduct toward a player in Sunday’s Arizona-New York Giants (Seeman) and Miami-Minnesota games (Hill).

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
The Broncos received some good news on both star CB Pat Surtain II and on WR Pat Bryant from their MRIs today, sources say.

They avoided worst-case scenario on both of their ankle injuries and both absences are expected to be short-term.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Chargers Pro Bowl OT Rashawn Slater is believed to have suffered a high-ankle sprain based on the initial exams, sources say. 
He'll have an MRI this morning, but that injury generally takes several weeks to heal. A hit to the LAC OL

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is believed to be day-to-day with his ankle injury, one that will be monitored and treated this coming week.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens CB Marlon Humphrey (calf) has been ruled out.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is questionable to return.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Marcus Mariota aggravated his MCL injury and now will have tests, per Molly McGrath. Expect him to miss some time.

That said, there is hope that QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) is back next week.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Commanders QB Marcus Mariota is officially questionable with a knee injury. Athan Kaliakmanis in at QB.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Steelers DT Derrick Harmon, who was carted off on Thursday night with a foot injury, is expected to miss a few weeks, source said.

IR would be a consideration for Harmon, though it’s not definite. Either way, not a long-term injury.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Panthers OT Monroe Freeling, who was in the NFL’s concussion protocol, has cleared and will play today against the Lions.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers, who was limited this week with a hamstring injury, is expected to play today, source said. He was questionable.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Texans veteran edge Jadeveon Clowney, questionable with a knee, is expected back on the field today, source said. He hasn’t played since the opener.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is likely to play today after battling a foot injury all week, source said. McConkey recently fought through a rib injury, and this is not considered as serious.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans was able to practice late this week despite a rib injury and said he’ll do his best to be out there. The team has expressed optimism, though as George Kittle noted, “Fractured ribs suck.”

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Commanders star WR Terry McLaurin is officially out for today’s game in London against the Colts. He suffered a hamstring injury late this week in practice

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: TItans RB Tyjae Spears, dealing with an ankle injury and questionable, is expected to play today.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Justin Jefferson has been ruled out

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson (ankle) for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: 49ers principal owner Jed York has been suspended for six regular-season games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL’s Personal Conduct Policy, the NFL announced today.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The 49ers are signing veteran DT Naquan Jones off the Vikings practice squad, per source.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is getting additional medical opinions on his injured knee that will determine whether to have surgery, which in turn will determine whether he can return this season or not. For now, he’s out indefinitely, as ESPN reported. Jameis Winston takes over as QB1.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Falcons placed CB A.J. Terrell on injured reserve.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks RB Jadarian Price, who left today’s game at Arizona with a chest injury, had X-rays that came back negative. More tests Monday, but there’s optimism he avoided any significant injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Commanders have officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels with a left elbow injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Ladd McConkey is officially active.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Sources: The #Seahawks are signing veteran QB Drew Lock, bringing him back to Seattle for a second stint. He will backup Sam Darnold.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Sources: Colorado QB Shedeur Sanders is scheduled to visit the #Raiders early next week. 

Las Vegas holds the No. 6 pick in the draft. They have been doing work on QBs and have other QB prospects also coming into their building.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Spoke with an NFL assistant GM about Alabama QB Jalen Milroe: “He’s one of the most intriguing guys in the entire draft. There’s a narrative that he’s just a running quarterback, but that’s way off...

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Former #Bucs OC Byron Leftwich is back in coaching as he is joining Deion Sanders’ staff at Colorado.

Leftwich interviewed for multiple NFL jobs this past cycle (Pats HC, Seahawks OC) but now makes the move to college.

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: #Bears GM Ryan Poles, via team statement: “This morning, after meeting with George and Kevin, we informed Matt of our decision to move in a different direction with the leadership of our football team and the head coaching position…”

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text:
Matt Eberflus at 9:30a: “I’m confident I’ll be prepping for SF and coaching this team.”

Matt Eberflus at noon: FIRED.

(Why would the #Bears let that man address reporters, knowing he wouldn’t make it thru the week, let alone the day?)

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: Will this game be over before I have to leave for Cincinnati on Saturday 🫠

posts.text: Ok, finally dipping my toe in these waters. I realllllly hope this is way less of a negative cesspool than X!
